title_sq: Tek Tulipan Residence ,Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Verande, Oborr Dhe 2 Poste Parkimi !
description_sq: Tek Tulipan Residence Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Verande, Oborr dhe 2 Poste Parkimi !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare , si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 123.76 m2, verande 116.8 m2 dhe oborri 112.4 m2 . Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, kendi i gatimit se bashku me dhomen e ndenjes me dalje ne verande, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet dhe garderobe, nje dhome gjumi femijesh dhe tualeti i dites me dritare. Rezidenca dallohet per punime mjaft cilesore dhe moderne. Aktualisht objekti eshte ne faze perfundimtare. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete. Bashke me apartamentin shiten dhe dy poste parkimi me cmim ekstra 25.000 euro secili.
title_en: At Tulipan Residence, Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with veranda, yard and 2 parking spaces!
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale at Tulipan Residence, with veranda, yard and 2 parking spaces!! The apartment is located on the first floor, and has a gross surface of 123.76 m2, veranda 116.8 m2 and yard 112.4 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the kitchen corner together with the living room with access to the veranda, a matrimonial bedroom with a toilet and wardrobe, a children's bedroom and a day toilet with a window. The residence stands out for high-quality and modern works. Currently, the object is in the final stage. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life. Together with the apartment, two parking spaces are sold with an extra price of 25,000 euros each.
